description: Modify production firewall rules (quorum — high risk module on prod)

playbook.content:
- name: Update firewall rules for new API
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        protocol: tcp
        destination_port: 8443
        jump: ACCEPT

tier_rationale: iptables on production without maintenance window — quorum required
